SELECT r.* FROM gkzh_jlcz_record r
ORDER BY r.record_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.result = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.result = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN r.total_weight END), 1), 0) AS avgTotalWeight, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN r.selected_count END), 1), 0) AS avgSelectedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN r.duration_ms END), 0), 0) AS avgDurationMs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.total_weight < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lt60, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.total_weight >= 60 AND r.total_weight < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS b60, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.total_weight >= 70 AND r.total_weight < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS b70, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.total_weight >= 80 AND r.total_weight < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS b80, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.total_weight >= 90 AND r.total_weight <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS b90, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.total_weight > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gt100 FROM gkzh_jlcz_record r

SELECT c.weight_no AS weightNo, c.weight_label AS weightLabel, c.weight_g AS weightG, c.category_code AS categoryCode, COUNT(DISTINCT c.record_id) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_jlcz_choice c JOIN gkzh_jlcz_record r ON r.record_id = c.record_id AND c.attempt_no = r.attempt_no
GROUP BY c.weight_no, c.weight_label, c.weight_g, c.category_code ORDER BY c.weight_no
SELECT * FROM gkzh_jlcz_record WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND game_type = 'jlcz' ORDER BY record_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
